mapper.sql: info.id, info.title, info.topic_content, info.status, info.del_flag, info.create_time, info.create_by, MAX(reply.create_time) as latestReplyDate, COUNT(DISTINCT reply.id) as replyNum, IFNULL(visit.visitNum, 0) as visitNum
SELECT tl.topic_id, GROUP_CONCAT(tl.label_id) as labels FROM tb_topic_label tl GROUP BY tl.topic_id
mapper.select:
SELECT t.id, t.title, t.topic_content as topicContent, t.status, t.del_flag as delFlag, t.create_time as createTime, t.create_by as createBy, t.latestReplyDate, t.replyNum, t.visitNum, tl.labels FROM ( SELECT
FROM tb_topic_info info LEFT JOIN tb_topic_reply reply ON info.id = reply.topic_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT topic_id, COUNT(id) as visitNum FROM tb_topic_visit GROUP BY topic_id ) visit ON info.id = visit.topic_id GROUP BY info.id ) t LEFT JOIN () tl ON t.id = tl.topic_id WHERE 1=1
AND t.status = '2' AND t.del_flag = '0'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_user_follow f WHERE f.topic_id = t.id AND f.user_id = #{username} ) AND t.status = '2' AND t.del_flag = '0'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_topic_reply r WHERE r.topic_id = t.id AND r.replyer_id = #{username} ) AND t.status = '2' AND t.del_flag = '0'
AND t.create_by = #{username}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_topic_reply_praise p WHERE p.topic_id = t.id AND p.create_by = #{username} ) AND t.status = '2' AND t.del_flag = '0'
AND t.status = '2' AND t.del_flag = '0'
AND t.status = '2' AND t.del_flag = '0'
AND ( t.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') OR t.topic_content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_topic_label l WHERE l.topic_id = t.id AND l.label_id = #{labelId} )
ORDER BY t.latestReplyDate DESC
ORDER BY t.replyNum DESC
ORDER BY t.create_time DESC
ORDER BY t.visitNum DESC
ORDER BY t.latestReplyDate DESC

SELECT id, title, topic_content as topicContent, status, del_flag as delFlag, create_time as createTime, create_by as createBy, update_time as updateTime, update_by as updateBy FROM tb_topic_info WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, title, create_time as createTime, create_by as createBy FROM tb_topic_info
AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND del_flag = '0' AND status = '2'
ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 100
